rules.title: Answer to Complaint
rules.description: Answer must be served within 20 days after service of summons (CPLR § 306)
rules.text: A defendant must serve and file an answer within 20 days after service of the summons.

rules.title: Motion to Dismiss
rules.description: Motion to dismiss for failure to state a cause of action (CPLR § 3211)
rules.text: A party may move to dismiss for failure to state a cause of action at any time.

rules.title: Discovery - Interrogatories
rules.description: Response to interrogatories must be served within 30 days (CPLR § 3101)
rules.text: Responses to interrogatories must be served within 30 days after being served.

rules.title: Discovery - Deposition
rules.description: Notice of deposition must be served within 10 days (CPLR § 3102)
rules.text: A notice of deposition must be served at least 10 days before the deposition date.

rules.title: Motion for Summary Judgment
rules.text: A motion for summary judgment may be made at any time after issue is joined.

localRules.title: Motion Practice
localRules.text: All motions require a statement of intended outcome and relief sought.
